title: Common Letter Patterns
introduction: Practise common letter patterns with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Two letters can work together to represent one sound, such as sh in ship.
rules: A digraph is two letters working together to represent a sound, such as sh in shell.
Learn patterns in context: sh, ch, th, ng, ck, ee, oo and ai. The same spelling may have different sounds in different words.
Listen to the voiced th in this and the unvoiced th in thin.
Read ship, shop, chin, chat and thin aloud.
Do not pronounce the two letters separately when they represent one sound.

examples.question: Complete: lu__ (nch or sh), a midday meal.
steps: The word ends in the ch sound.

examples.question: Find the pattern in ring.
steps: The last two letters represent the sound at the end.

examples.question: Complete: tr__ (ee or ai), a tall plant.
steps: Ee represents the long vowel sound.

examples.question: Complete: r__n (ai or ee), water falling from the sky.

exercises.question: Complete: __op (sh or ch), a place to buy things.
exercises.solution: The sh pattern represents the first sound in shop.

exercises.question: Complete: __eese (ch or th), a dairy food.
exercises.solution: The ch pattern represents the first sound in cheese.

exercises.question: Complete: __ree (th or sh), number 3.
exercises.solution: The th pattern represents the first sound in three.

exercises.question: Complete: ri__ (ng or ck), jewellery for a finger.
exercises.solution: The ng pattern represents the last sound in ring.

exercises.question: Complete: ne__ (ck or ng), joins the head to the body.
exercises.solution: The ck pattern represents the final /k/ sound in neck.

exercises.question: Complete: f__t (ee or ai), plural of foot.
exercises.solution: The ee pattern gives the long ee sound in feet.

exercises.question: Complete: sp__n (oo or ee), a tool for eating soup.
exercises.solution: The oo pattern gives the long oo sound in spoon.

exercises.question: Complete: tr__n (ai or ee), a railway vehicle.
exercises.solution: The ai pattern gives the long a sound in train.

exercises.question: Which begins like chair: cheese or shell?
exercises.solution: Chair and cheese begin with the same ch sound.

exercises.question: Which ends like sing: king or sock?
exercises.solution: Sing and king end with the same ng sound.

summary: Two letters can work together to represent one sound, such as sh in ship.
